title: NorthPole - IBM neural inference architecture
summary: IBM's NorthPole is a 12-nm process chip featuring 256 programmable cores with integrated on-chip SRAM to eliminate off-chip memory. Designed for low-precision (8, 4, and 2-bit) neural network inference, it minimizes data movement via spatial computing inspired by brain pathways. The architecture utilizes four distinct Network-on-Chip networks for activations, communication, weights, and instructions. A co-designed software toolchain automates model mapping, orchestration, and quantization-aware training. Published in Science (October 2023), the system operates as a self-sufficient active memory device.
tldr: IBM's NorthPole is an energy-efficient neural inference chip using on-chip memory integration to eliminate off-chip access for low-precision AI tasks.
